name: Not Where You Aimed
flavor: Sidestep a thrown bottle, step clear of falling slate, get out from under a crate as it tips, or lean out of a punch in a tavern. One step, one thing coming at you.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction targets you, before its roll. Response (unopposed): Move 1 unit and gain +1 Fortitude against that Action. Recheck range afterward.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain for that movement.
surge2_html: If the attack still hits, reduce its Damage by 1.

name: An Obvious Mistake
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses you with a melee Action. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: After a hit, move 1 unit.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.

name: You Looked Away
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy declares an Action against someone other than you while you have cover from it. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage before that Action continues.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: After resolving, move 1 unit toward cover.

name: Pull the Other Wire
flavor:
Redirect a snare you set so it catches the pursuer and not your friend, hold a trap back until the right man is on it, or spring it a step early so a mule walks around it. Your trap, your timing.

Not enough to move a trap someone else laid.
target_html: Self; one enemy within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: That enemy would trigger your unspent Contingency. Response (unopposed): Retarget its effect to another legal target within 1 unit of the original, or delay it until the end of that enemy's current Action.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit as you make the adjustment.
surge2_html: After the Contingency resolves, one enemy it affected becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.

name: Read the Follow-Through
flavor: Roll with a shove, see a punch coming in a tavern and take it on the shoulder, let a falling crate hit the ground instead of you, or ride a horse's buck instead of fighting it. You still get hit, just not as hard.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1. If the attacker was Exposed when the Action began, reduce it by 2 instead.
surge1_html: After the Action, move 1 unit.
surge2_html: After the Action, the attacker becomes Exposed if detected and within 3 units.

name: Sweeten the Bait
flavor:
Let a liar overplay his hand, lead a boaster into claiming more than he can back up, or give a cheat the opening that makes him clumsy. One person, one try, and he is worse at it than he should be.

Not enough to make anyone stop trying or to fool more than one.
target_html: One detected enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy declares an attack against you, before rolling. Response: On success, impose -1 on that attack's Success Die; you take -1 Fortitude against it if your Reaction misses.
surge1_html: After a hit, move 1 unit away.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress its ordinary accuracy bonuses for that attack, to a maximum reduction of 1.

name: Leave Them Holding It
flavor: Slip a grabbing hand and leave your cloak in it, twist out of a rope before the knot bites, or wriggle free of a guard's grip for one step. If he still reaches you, he has you again.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction imposes an ordinary restraint on you. Response (unopposed): Suppress that restraint during a 1-unit move. It ends if its source no longer reaches you; otherwise it resumes.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: If you escape, the restraining enemy becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.

name: The Second Blind Spot
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses an Action while Exposed, or ends an Action without detecting you despite your nearby concealment. Response: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: After a hit, move 1 unit around it.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.

name: Catch the Trigger
flavor:
Catch a tripwire before it springs, pull a friend off a pressure plate, kick a falling beam aside, or take the worst of a collapsing shelf for someone who did not see it. Whatever is set to go off, you take the teeth out of it.

Not enough to stop the trap entirely or to disarm it for good.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: A visible mundane trap or terrain hazard would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 2.
surge1_html: Move the protected creature 1 unit to a safe adjacent space after the hazard resolves.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that hazard until the start of your next turn.

name: The Cost of Overreach
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses you with an Action for which it rolled at least 3 dice. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and move it 1 unit sideways.
surge1_html: After a hit, move into its vacated space.
surge2_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage if it is beside an obstacle.

name: A Better Place to Be
flavor:
Pull a friend out from under collapsing scaffolding, yank someone clear of a runaway cart, haul an ally out of a crowd that is about to turn, or get two steps away from a barrel before it rolls. You or one friend, a few paces, out of the way.

Not enough to move anyone who does not want to go or to clear more than one person.
target_html: Self or an adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move the target up to 2 units along a clear path, then recheck whether it remains in the area.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
surge2_html: If still affected, reduce the Action's Damage to the target by 1.

name: Lateral Fold
flavor:
Sidestep a falling tile, a thrown mug, or a hand reaching for your purse, one step without planting a foot. Get out from under a dropped sack.

Not enough to dodge a collapse or get out of a room.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction targets you, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Move 1 unit along a clear path; gain +1 Fortitude against that Action. Recheck target validity afterward.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during that movement.
surge2_html: Move 1 additional unit, ending in a supported space.

name: Penumbra Intercession
flavor:
Soften a thrown punch, take a thrown stone on a cushion of shadow, or shade your eyes from a lantern swung in your face. One blow, one moment.

Not enough to stop a falling beam or turn a blade.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: A detected enemy's Action would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1.
surge1_html: After the Action, your space provides concealment until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary visual impairment imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.

name: Cauterized Vector
flavor:
When a bottle or a stone is thrown at you and misses, flash a spark back at the thrower and light their hiding spot. Catch an ambusher in a window, a rooftop, or a dark doorway.

Not enough to burn anyone badly or light a whole alley.
target_html: One enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses you with a ranged Action. Response: On success, deal 1 Fire Damage and illuminate its space until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Ignore ordinary concealment for this attack.
surge2_html: Suppress 1 point of its next ordinary magical Damage reduction until the start of your next turn.

name: Liquid Rebuttal
flavor:
Keep your feet when a crowd surges, a horse shies, a deck pitches, a river tugs at your legs, or a drunk shoves you off a bench. Hold one friend steady through the same.

Not enough to stand in a flood or stop a cart.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would push, pull or knock the target Prone. Response (unopposed): Reduce forced movement by 2 units and suppress that Prone effect until the Action finishes.
surge1_html: The protected creature may move 1 unit after the Action.
surge2_html: Reduce Damage from that Action by 1.

name: Windward Answer
flavor:
Turn a thrown stone or a falling slate with a gust and step one person out from under it. Catch an arrow from ambush on the wind before it lands.

Not enough to stop a collapse or move anyone more than a step.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: A ranged physical Action targets the creature, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 Fortitude against that attack and move the creature 1 unit.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit along a supported path.
surge2_html: If the attack still hits, reduce its Damage by 1.

name: An Instant Held Open
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The target rolls a Combat Card with a Success Die below 6, before spending Surges. Response (unopposed): Increase that Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 6; this changes no Surge generation.
surge1_html: The target ignores one ordinary -1 Success Die penalty on that card.
surge2_html: After that card, the target may move 1 unit. This grants no additional Action.

name: Counterseal
flavor:
Shrug off a sleep charm long enough to get out of the room, hold a hex at bay through a conversation, or steady a friend under a curse until they finish a climb. It comes back when the moment passes.

Not enough to break a curse or undo a lasting enchantment.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction imposes an ordinary magical Condition on the target. Response (unopposed): Suppress that Condition until the start of your next turn. Specialty and Wound Conditions are unaffected.
surge1_html: Suppress ordinary concealment penalties against the source for the target's next card until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: Stone Remembers the Blow
flavor:
Brace a friend against a falling beam, a horse's kick, a rockfall, or a swung club, and leave a low screen of stone beside them to duck behind. One blow, one person.

Not enough to hold up a roof or stop a cart.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal physical Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2; afterward create a temporary low screen in an adjacent empty space until the start of your next turn, with 1 Wound and 0 Resilience.
surge1_html: The screen may be placed within 2 units of the target instead.
surge2_html: The target also resists up to 2 units of forced movement from the Action.

name: The Distance Between
flavor:
Pull one person clear of a collapsing floor, a flood surge, a toppling shelf, or a spreading fire with two quick steps before it reaches them.

Not enough to carry anyone out of a building or escape a whole avalanche.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move the target up to 2 units along a clear path, then recheck whether it remains in the area.
surge1_html: Increase displacement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary restraint during that displacement; it resumes if its source still reaches the destination.

name: Eclipse of Intent
flavor:
Spoil a pickpocket's reach, make a guard's search miss what you carry, cloud the eye of a sentry who has just spotted a friend, or fog the look of someone lying to your face. Drop a shadow over the spot they were watching.

Not enough to blind anyone or hide a whole room.
target_html: One detected enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy declares a single-target Action against you or an ally within 3 units. Response: On success, impose -2 on its Success Die for that Action; its target's space gains concealment afterward until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Another adjacent space also gains concealment.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress one ordinary accuracy bonus on that Action, to a maximum of 1.

name: Mercurial Refraction
flavor:
Turn a gout of flame into a cold wind, a lightning strike into a hard shove, or a splash of acid into a harmless spray before it reaches one person. Soften it on the way.

Not enough to shield a crowd or stop a blow that is not magical.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Change that Damage to another listed type and reduce it by 1. Conditions do not change.
surge1_html: The target also resists 1 unit of forced movement from the Action.
surge2_html: Reduce that Damage by 1 more.

name: Reflexive Boundary
flavor:
Soften a fall from a cart, take a thrown stone without a bruise, blunt a trap's dart, or catch a dropped pot before it breaks against you.

Not enough to walk away from a long fall or a collapsing roof.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1.
surge1_html: Reduce its forced movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: If you accepted Strain for this card, suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.

name: A Fraction Before Impact
flavor: Sidestep a thrown mug, step off a trapdoor as it opens, slip a drunk's grab, or feel a lie coming and keep your face still.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction targets you before its roll. Response (unopposed): Gain +1 to the targeted Defense against that Action.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit after the Action resolves.
surge2_html: If the Action misses and you accepted no Strain on this card, remove 1 Strain.

name: Violent Feedback
flavor:
Sting back at whoever just reached into your head, a hedge-wizard's hex, a mesmerist's push, a haunting. Learn whether their body or their mind is the weaker.

Not enough to break the hold on you or trace them farther than the room.
target_html: One enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy deals Psychic or Arcane Damage to you with an Action. Response: After its Damage, on success deal 1 Psychic Damage.
surge1_html: On a hit, learn whether its Harmony or Composure is lower.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Psychic Damage if you accepted Strain for this card.

name: Arrest the Vector
flavor:
Catch a friend slipping off a ledge, hold a child against a river current, stop a rider from being thrown by a bolting horse, or keep someone from going over a rooftop edge.

Not enough to stop a cart or a falling tree.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would force the target to move. Response (unopposed): Reduce that movement by 3 units.
surge1_html: Prevent a Prone effect imposed by that same Action.
surge2_html: Reduce the Action's Damage to the target by 1.

name: Warn the Other Self
flavor:
Make a friend duck a thrown bottle without a word spoken, show a companion the pickpocket's hand before it closes, or point out the window the arrow came from.

Not enough to warn more than one person at a time.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature from a source you detect, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to the targeted Defense against that attack and reveal the source's occupied space to the target.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit toward you.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary sensory penalty on the target until the start of your next turn.

name: Break the Pattern
target_html: One detected enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy declares the same Combat Card it used on its previous Action. Response: On success, impose -1 on that card's Success Die and make it Slowed 1 after resolving until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of ordinary accuracy bonus on that card.

name: Ground the Surge
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Trigger: An enemy Action misses you while you have Strain. Response (unopposed): Do not accept Strain on this card. Remove 1 Strain and move 1 unit.
surge1_html: Gain +1 Composure against that enemy until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress the Harmony penalty from your remaining Strain until the start of your next turn; the Strain remains.

name: Between Intention and Motion
flavor:
Pull a friend from under a falling beam and roll clear, blunt a fall from a roof, take a horse's kick for someone and step them away, or shield one person from a cave-in.

Not enough to shelter a crowd or stop a wall from coming down.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2; afterward the target may move 1 unit.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Prevent one ordinary Prone or Slowed effect imposed by that Action.

name: A Mind at Two Windows
flavor:
Pull a friend clear of a collapsing scaffold, out of a spreading fire, off a bridge as it gives way, or out of the path of a stampede.

Not enough to move more than one person or carry anyone farther than a few steps.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move it up to 2 units toward a visible empty supported space; recheck the area afterward.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
surge2_html: Detect ordinarily concealed enemies within 2 units of the destination until the start of your next turn.

name: Reciprocal Discontinuity
flavor:
Shake off a charm and leave the charmer reeling, throw a mesmerist's push back in his face, or dismiss a fear sent at you and stagger whoever sent it.

Not enough to break a hold set on someone else or hurt the sender for long.
target_html: One detected enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy successfully imposes an ordinary mental Condition on you. Response: On success, suppress that Condition on you until the start of your next turn and make the enemy Distracted for the same duration.
surge1_html: On a hit, give it -1 Composure until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: On a hit, deal 1 Psychic Damage.

name: Body After the Signal
target_html: One living enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy finishes voluntary movement while Slowed. Response: On success, deal 2 Force Damage.
surge1_html: On a hit, move it 1 unit sideways.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of its next ordinary Movement bonus until the start of your next turn.
